const colorMap = { primary: 'var(--primary)', azure: 'var(--azure)', purple: 'var(--purple)', yellow: 'var(--yellow)', red: 'var(--red)', green: 'var(--green)', blue: 'var(--blue)' }; const tbody = document.getElementById('orders-rows'); function formatBytes(bytes, decimals = 2) { if (!+bytes) return '0 Bytes'; const k = 1024; const dm = decimals < 0 ? 0 : decimals; const sizes = ['Bytes', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB', 'TB', 'PB', 'EB', 'ZB', 'YB']; const i = Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(k)); return `${parseFloat((bytes / Math.pow(k, i)).toFixed(dm))} ${sizes[i]}`; } function truncate(str, n) { return str.length > n ? str.slice(0, n - 1) + '…' : str; } function rowHtml(o) { const shortDesc = o.desc && o.desc.length > 2 ? truncate(o.desc, 60) : 'No description provided'; return ` ${o.id}
${o.initials}
${o.name}
${shortDesc} ${formatBytes(o.size)} ${o.createdAt} `; } function skeletonRows(n = 5) { const cell = ''; return Array.from({ length: n }, () => `${cell.repeat(6)}`).join(''); } async function load() { tbody.innerHTML = skeletonRows(); try { const res = await fetch('skills_data.json'); if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Failed to fetch skills data'); const skills = await res.json(); document.getElementById('stat-total-skills').innerText = skills.length; document.getElementById('stat-agents-skills').innerText = skills.filter(s => s.path.includes('.agents') ).length; document.getElementById('stat-gemini-skills').innerText = skills.filter(s => s.path.includes('.gemini') ).length; if (!skills.length) { tbody.innerHTML = `No skills found.`; return; } tbody.innerHTML = skills.map(rowHtml).join(''); } catch (err) { tbody.innerHTML = `
Failed to load skills. ${err.message || err}
`; document.getElementById('orders-retry')?.addEventListener('click', load); } } load();
